title: The Kitchen

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The Kitchen's warm and welcoming atmosphere features a beautiful open kitchen, a spacious floor plan and reclaimed early twentieth-century architectural details including walls of exposed brick. We're all about the details, making The Kitchen an ideal venue for any celebration! Host a Catered Event, a Participatory Dining Experience, or a Team Building Activity The Kitchen's signature offering is our Participatory Dining Experience, an interactive event that brings people together to create memories through food. You and your guests will be guided through the best parts of cooking, from chopping to sautéing to baking. You do the fun parts, while our team takes care of the rest. The Kitchen

blurb: The Kitchen’s two versatile event spaces bring people together to celebrate and create warm memories through shared food experiences. Located in German Village, our venues are perfect for corporate events, weddings, rehearsal dinners, birthday celebrations and more!
